Indicators: SIAM segment volumes; FADA/VAHAN retail; wholesale-retail gap; bookings; inventory
Action trigger: If wholesale exceeds retail persistently and inventory/discounts rise, pause additions.

Indicators: Realisation, segment margin, material cost, EBITDA and price actions
Action trigger: If input costs rise while margins and cash flow deteriorate, cut the affected position.

Indicators: CFO, capex, net debt, working capital and interest cover
Action trigger: If earnings fail to convert into cash or leverage rises beyond plan, re-rate risk.

Indicators: EV share, price competitiveness, contribution margin, warranty, charging uptime
Action trigger: If volumes rise but losses or warranty costs expand, reduce EV premium assumption.

Indicators: PM E-DRIVE notifications, CAFE timetable, safety / localisation requirements
Action trigger: Recalculate product mix, compliance capex and eligible incentive assumptions.

Indicators: Lead times, single-source parts, gas/power, supplier financial health
Action trigger: Escalate when a critical part has no qualified alternate or production buffer.

Indicators: P/E vs own history, earnings revisions, price vs 50/200DMA, RSI/volume
Action trigger: Trim when multiple rerates without earnings; add only when fair value and trend gates align.
